```{r}
# ── 2. Publication Visualization Rules ──────────────────────────────────

# A. Discrete Color Palette (Okabe-Ito: Colorblind safe, high contrast)
pub_discrete <- c(
  "#E69F00", # Orange
  "#56B4E9", # Light Blue
  "#009E73", # Green
  "#F0E442", # Yellow
  "#0072B2", # Dark Blue
  "#D55E00", # Vermilion
  "#CC79A7"  # Reddish Purple
)

# B. Master ggplot Theme for standard plots (scatter, bar, dumbbell)
theme_publication <- function(base_size = 11, base_family = "sans") {
  theme_minimal(base_size = base_size, base_family = base_family) +
    theme(
      plot.title    = element_text(face = "bold", size = rel(1.2), margin = margin(b = 5)),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = rel(0.9), colour = "grey40", margin = margin(b = 15)),
      plot.caption  = element_text(size = rel(0.7), colour = "grey50", hjust = 0, margin = margin(t = 15)),
      axis.title.x  = element_text(face = "bold", margin = margin(t = 10)),
      axis.title.y  = element_text(face = "bold", margin = margin(r = 10)),
      axis.text     = element_text(colour = "black"),
      axis.line     = element_line(colour = "black", linewidth = 0.3),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = "grey90", linewidth = 0.3),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.title    = element_text(face = "bold", size = rel(0.9)),
      legend.text     = element_text(size = rel(0.8)),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
      plot.background  = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA)
    )
}

# C. Master ggplot Theme specifically for MAPS (removes axes and grids)
theme_publication_map <- function(base_size = 11, base_family = "sans") {
  theme_publication(base_size, base_family) %+replace%
    theme(
      axis.text = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks = element_blank(),
      axis.line = element_blank(),
      axis.title = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    )
}
```

```{r}

poi_sf <- poi_sf %>% mutate(buffer = st_buffer(geometry, dist = BUFFER_DIST))

buffers_by_type <- poi_sf %>% group_by(store_type) %>% summarise(geometry = st_union(buffer), .groups = "drop")
buffer_all <- poi_sf %>% summarise(geometry = st_union(buffer))
```

```{r}
compute_coverage <- function(boundaries, buffers_by_type, buffer_all, id_col) {
  boundaries <- boundaries %>% mutate(area_m2 = as.numeric(st_area(geometry)))
  id_col_sym <- sym(id_col)
  store_types <- buffers_by_type$store_type
  cov_cols <- character(0)

  for (st in store_types) {
    buf <- buffers_by_type %>% filter(store_type == !!st)
    col_name <- paste0(tolower(st), "_coverage")
    inter <- st_intersection(boundaries %>% select(all_of(id_col), geometry), buf)
    overlap_df <- inter %>%
      mutate(overlap_m2 = as.numeric(st_area(geometry))) %>%
      as.data.frame() %>%
      group_by(!!id_col_sym) %>%
      summarise(overlap_m2 = sum(overlap_m2), .groups = "drop") %>%
      rename(!!col_name := overlap_m2)

    boundaries <- boundaries %>%
      left_join(overlap_df, by = id_col) %>%
      mutate(!!col_name := (!!sym(col_name)) / area_m2 * 100,
             !!col_name := replace_na(!!sym(col_name), 0))
    cov_cols <- c(cov_cols, col_name)
  }

  inter_all <- st_intersection(boundaries %>% select(all_of(id_col), geometry), buffer_all)
  total_df <- inter_all %>%
    mutate(total_m2 = as.numeric(st_area(geometry))) %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    group_by(!!id_col_sym) %>%
    summarise(total_m2 = sum(total_m2), .groups = "drop") %>%
    rename(total_coverage = total_m2)

  boundaries <- boundaries %>%
    left_join(total_df, by = id_col) %>%
    mutate(
      total_coverage = total_coverage / area_m2 * 100,
      total_coverage = replace_na(total_coverage, 0),
      overlap_index = !!sym(cov_cols[1]) + !!sym(cov_cols[2]) + !!sym(cov_cols[3]) - total_coverage,
      unique_types = (!!sym(cov_cols[1]) > 0) + (!!sym(cov_cols[2]) > 0) + (!!sym(cov_cols[3]) > 0)
    ) %>% select(-area_m2)

  return(boundaries)
}
```

```{r}
lsoa_cov <- compute_coverage(lsoa_geom, buffers_by_type, buffer_all, "lsoa_code")
msoa_cov <- compute_coverage(msoa_geom, buffers_by_type, buffer_all, "MSOA11CD")
ward_cov <- compute_coverage(ward_geom, buffers_by_type, buffer_all, "WD11CD")
bor_cov <- compute_coverage(bor_geom, buffers_by_type, buffer_all, "borough_code")
```

```{r}
# Using theme_publication_map() and a standardized continuous spatial palette (magma)
make_panel <- function(gdf, title, point_size = 0.3) {
  p <- ggplot(gdf) +
    geom_sf(aes(fill = total_coverage), colour = NA, linewidth = 0) +
    geom_sf(data = poi_sf, colour = "black", size = point_size, alpha = 0.4) +
    scale_fill_viridis_c(
      option = "magma", direction = -1,
      labels = percent_format(scale = 1, suffix = "%")
    ) +
    labs(
      title = title,
      subtitle = sprintf("Mean = %.1f%% | SD = %.1f%%", 
                         mean(gdf$total_coverage, na.rm = TRUE), 
                         sd(gdf$total_coverage, na.rm = TRUE))
    ) +
    theme_publication_map(base_size = 10) +
    theme(legend.position = "none")
  
  if (nrow(gdf) <= 40) p <- p + geom_sf(colour = "white", linewidth = 0.3, fill = NA)
  p
}

p1 <- make_panel(lsoa_cov, "LSOA Level", point_size = 0.2)
p2 <- make_panel(msoa_cov, "MSOA Level", point_size = 0.3)
p3 <- make_panel(ward_cov, "Ward Level", point_size = 0.3)
p4 <- make_panel(bor_cov,  "London Borough Level", point_size = 0.8)

# Legend on MSOA panel
p2 <- p2 + theme(legend.position = "right", legend.key.height = unit(1.5, "cm")) + labs(fill = "Coverage")

(p1 | p2) / (p3 | p4) +
  plot_layout(heights = c(1, 1)) +
  plot_annotation(
    title = "Tesco Store Accessibility Across London: Multi-Scale Comparison",
    subtitle = "15-minute walking buffer coverage (% of area covered)",
    theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16), plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12, colour = "grey40"))
  )
```

```{r}
grocery <- read.csv(file.path(PROJ, "tesco-data/7796666/year_lsoa_grocery.csv"))
FOOD_CATEGORIES <- c("f_beer", "f_dairy", "f_eggs", "f_fats_oils", "f_fish",
                     "f_fruit_veg", "f_grains", "f_meat_red", "f_poultry",
                     "f_readymade", "f_soft_drinks", "f_sweets", "f_wine")
available <- FOOD_CATEGORIES[FOOD_CATEGORIES %in% names(grocery)]

X_food <- grocery %>% select(all_of(available)) %>% mutate(across(everything(), ~ replace_na(.x, 0)))
pca_fit <- prcomp(X_food, scale. = TRUE)
pca_lsoa <- data.frame(lsoa_code = grocery$area_id, PC1 = pca_fit$x[, 1], PC2 = pca_fit$x[, 2])
```

```{r}
imd <- read.csv(file.path(CSV, "imd_subdomains.csv"))
lookup <- read.csv(file.path(PROJ, "data/raw/lsoa_full_lookup.csv"))
pop <- read.csv(file.path(PROJ, "tesco-data/7796666/year_lsoa_grocery.csv")) %>% select(lsoa_code = area_id, population)

domain_names <- c("income", "employment", "education", "health", "crime", "barriers", "living_environment")

msoa_df <- pca_lsoa %>%
  inner_join(imd, by = "lsoa_code") %>%
  inner_join(lookup %>% select(lsoa_code, MSOA11CD), by = "lsoa_code") %>%
  inner_join(pop, by = "lsoa_code") %>%
  filter(!is.na(PC1), !is.na(PC2), population > 0) %>%
  group_by(MSOA11CD) %>%
  summarise(across(all_of(c("PC1", "PC2", "imd_score", domain_names)), ~ weighted.mean(.x, w = population, na.rm = TRUE), .names = "{.col}"), .groups = "drop")

z_vars <- c("PC1", "PC2", "imd_score", domain_names)
msoa_df <- msoa_df %>% mutate(across(all_of(z_vars), scale, .names = "{.col}_z"))
```

```{r}
# The new spatial PCA maps using the diverging scale and theme_publication_map()
msoa_pca_spatial <- msoa_geom %>% left_join(msoa_df, by = "MSOA11CD") %>% filter(!is.na(PC1))

plot_spatial_pca <- function(spatial_data, metric, title, subtitle) {
  ggplot(spatial_data) +
    geom_sf(aes_string(fill = metric), colour = NA, linewidth = 0) +
    geom_sf(data = bor_geom, fill = NA, colour = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
    scale_fill_distiller(palette = "RdBu", direction = -1, name = "Z-Score", limits = c(-3, 3), oob = scales::squish) +
    labs(title = title, subtitle = subtitle) +
    theme_publication_map() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5), plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
      legend.position = "bottom", legend.key.width = unit(1.5, "cm")
    )
}

map_pc1 <- plot_spatial_pca(msoa_pca_spatial, "PC1_z", "Spatial Distribution of 'Convenience' Purchasing (PC1)", "High scores indicate reliance on processed/ready-made foods")
map_pc2 <- plot_spatial_pca(msoa_pca_spatial, "PC2_z", "Spatial Distribution of 'Variety' Purchasing (PC2)", "High scores indicate a broader, more diverse grocery basket")

map_pc1 + map_pc2 + plot_layout(ncol = 2) + plot_annotation(caption = "Borough boundaries overlaid in white.", theme = theme(plot.caption = element_text(colour = "grey50", hjust = 0.5)))
```

```{r}
model_a_pc1 <- lm(PC1_z ~ imd_score_z, data = msoa_df)
model_b_pc1 <- lm(as.formula(paste("PC1_z ~", paste(domain_names, collapse = " + "))), data = msoa_df)
```

```{r}
X_mat <- as.matrix(msoa_df[, domain_names])
y_pc1 <- msoa_df$PC1_z

set.seed(42)
cv_pc1 <- cv.glmnet(X_mat, y_pc1, alpha = 1, nfolds = 5)
lasso_pc1 <- glmnet(X_mat, y_pc1, alpha = 1, lambda = cv_pc1$lambda.min)
lasso_coefs_pc1 <- as.numeric(coef(lasso_pc1))[-1]
names(lasso_coefs_pc1) <- domain_names
```

```{r}
# The new Dumbbell Plot using theme_publication()
domain_labels <- c(income = "Income", employment = "Employment", education = "Education", health = "Health", crime = "Crime", barriers = "Barriers to Housing", living_environment = "Living Environment")

ols_df <- tidy(model_b_pc1) %>% filter(term != "(Intercept)") %>% select(term, ols_coef = estimate)
lasso_df <- data.frame(term = names(lasso_coefs_pc1), lasso_coef = lasso_coefs_pc1)

dumbbell_df <- ols_df %>%
  inner_join(lasso_df, by = "term") %>%
  mutate(
    term = recode(term, !!!domain_labels),
    term = fct_reorder(term, abs(ols_coef), .desc = FALSE),
    eliminated = ifelse(abs(lasso_coef) < 1e-5, TRUE, FALSE)
  )

ggplot(dumbbell_df) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey70", linewidth = 0.5, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_segment(aes(x = ols_coef, xend = lasso_coef, y = term, yend = term), colour = "grey60", linewidth = 1, arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.2, "cm"), type = "closed")) +
  geom_point(aes(x = ols_coef, y = term), colour = pub_discrete[5], size = 3.5, shape = 16) + # Dark Blue for OLS
  geom_point(aes(x = lasso_coef, y = term, fill = eliminated), shape = 21, colour = "black", size = 3.5, stroke = 0.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("FALSE" = pub_discrete[6], "TRUE" = "white")) + # Vermilion for LASSO
  labs(
    title = "Impact of L1 Regularization on Deprivation Sub-Domains",
    subtitle = "Arrows indicate coefficient shrinkage from standard OLS to LASSO (PC1: Convenience)",
    x = "Standardised Coefficient", y = NULL,
    caption = "Blue = OLS Estimate | Vermilion = LASSO Estimate | White = Eliminated by penalty"
  ) +
  theme_publication() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_text(face = "bold")
  )
```
